sources: Esri World Imagery around the 35 UseDirect site points

values.note: Same rates on the 2026 and 2027 sheets. On-season (Apr-Oct): basic $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29. Off-season (Nov-Mar): basic $14, electric 30A $23, electric 50A $25. Rates include sales tax.

fees.source: Finger Lakes 2027 camping-rate sheet (https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/finger-lake-camping-fees-2027.pdf, linked from https://mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes/camping as '2027 Camping Rates'), read 2026-11-08

hookups.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes/camping ('basic and 30-amp and 50-amp electric campsites') + UseDirect grid for facility 772 (10 'Electric 30 amp', 6 'Electric 50 amp', 19 'Basic'; no water or sewer unit types), read 2026-11-08

values.note: 35 bookable sites on the booking site: 19 basic (#18-36), 10 electric 30A (#1-10), 6 electric 50A (#11-13, 15-17); site 14 is the campground host. Vehicle lengths 35-58 ft except basic #28 (81 ft, ADA), so every site takes a 23-ft rig.

sites.source: UseDirect grid for facility 772 (unit names and per-unit VehicleLength, arrival 2027-05-11) + https://mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes/camping ('the campground host at Site 14'), read 2026-11-08

values.note: Showers and modern restrooms April-October only; off-season water near site 14 and at the dump station, which is open year-round. Wi-Fi only near the showerhouse.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes/camping (amenity symbols: restroom, vault toilet, running water, shower, dump station; 'Showers and modern restrooms are available only during the on-season (April through October)'; 'potable water is available near Site 14 and the dump station, which is open year-round'; 'Wi-Fi is available near the showerhouse'), read 2026-11-08

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes/camping ('up to 12 months in advance'; 'The campground is fully reservable. Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved'; 'any 15 days within a 30-consecutive-day period'), read 2026-11-08

note: Campground in an ATV/off-road-motorcycle state park built on reclaimed coal-mine land; ATVs and motorcycles may not ride around the campground. Park gate closes at 10 pm (campers get the code). --Claude
summary: General campground with an ORV side (ATVs barred from the campground) - keep. 2027 sheet confirms fees ($14/$15 basic, 30A/50A electric); UseDirect: 35 bookable (19 basic, 10 30A, 6 50A) + host site 14, 35-81 ft. Changed sites 36 -> 35, max_rig_ft 46 -> 81; added facilities and confirmed reservable/12-month/15-night/walk-up-when-unreserved. Not waterfront confirmed: the nearest strip-pit lake is ~100 m past a treeline from sites 24-25. Pin was 1.7 km south.
flags: OHV check: a general campground with an ORV side, not a staging camp - keep. Park page: 'one of two ATV parks in the state parks system ... trails and motocross track are popular with users who come for the day, but often fall under the spell of the spacious campground'; camping page: 'ATVs and motorcycles are prohibited from riding around the campground.' The park also has swimming, fishing, a mountain-bike trail and a 4.5-mile water trail.
Pin moved: 39.0890,-92.3175 is ~1.67 km south of the campground; the 35 UseDirect site points centre on 39.1040,-92.3174 (the central loop by sites 26-33). Suggest 39.1040,-92.3174.
Phone missing from the entry: park office 573-443-5315 (mostateparks.com/park/finger-lakes).

Waterfront (not waterfront) confirmed from the site points: the closest water is a narrow strip-pit lake west of sites 24-25, ~100 m away behind woods and the access road; two small ponds south of the loop are sewage-lagoon-like basins ~70 m from sites 29-31 (well under 5 acres).
